title: Spicy Mushroom Empanadas
description: A twist on traditional Thai street food, these empanadas are filled with sautéed mushrooms and served with a side of spicy sauce.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour and salt. Gradually add water, mixing until dough forms.
Knead dough for 5 minutes. Divide into 8 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place 1-2 tablespoons of mushroom filling in the center of each circle.
Fold dough in half and press edges together to seal.
Brush tops with beaten egg and bake for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add 1-2 empanadas to the pan and fry until golden brown.
Serve hot with spicy sauce (see notes)
